status_summary: No change to IARPA's mission, status or budget was found, and the ODNI 2.0 release of 2025-08-20 does not mention IARPA (ODNI). On 2026-06-30 the CIA Director described a reorganization that renamed the Directorate of Digital Innovation as the Directorate of Mission Systems, moved offensive cyber and open-source work out of it, and created an Office of Corporate Partnerships and a faster commercial technology acquisition framework to draw on private-sector innovation (FedScoop; Federal News Network). Those steps do not address the Science and Technology directorate or IARPA, so they are a parallel match only.

timeline.event: In public remarks at an industry summit, the CIA Director described a completed reorganization: the Directorate of Digital Innovation had become the Directorate of Mission Systems, offensive cyber had moved to an elevated Center for Cyber Intelligence, and an Office of Corporate Partnerships and a commercial technology acquisition framework had been set up.

title: Refocus IARPA and CIA science and technology on hard problems, not private-sector work
uncertainties: The 2026-06-30 date is the date of the Director's remarks and of the FedScoop report; the effective dates of the reorganization steps were not given. The coverage did not mention the Science and Technology directorate. Only the first 100,000 characters of the FY2026 authorization text on the Senate intelligence committee site were read by the researcher, and no IARPA provision appeared in that portion. A Federal Register term search for IARPA since 2025-01-20 returned nothing. Searches run by the researcher: ODNI 2.0 and IARPA, IARPA budget and authorization, IARPA 2026 news, CIA S&T reorganization. Judgment: not_started would also be defensible, since nothing reached the named organizations.
